name: How do I choose a contractor for a foreclosed property renovation?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose a contractor for a foreclosed property renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a contractor for a foreclosed property renovation, look for experience with similar projects and a strong understanding of local building codes. Check their licensing, insurance, and references. Obtain multiple detailed bids that clearly outline the scope of work, timeline, and payment schedule. A good contractor will communicate effectively, provide transparent pricing, and offer a warranty on their work. Prioritize those who specialize in comprehensive renovations.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor with experience in similar projects, local code knowledge, proper licensing, insurance, and good references. Get multiple detailed bids.
